entries.content: All action checks utilize a d20 system. You add your attribute modifier to the roll. The modifier equals your attribute minus fifty, divided by ten, rounded.
Tasks follow a set difficulty scale. Trivial is five. Easy is ten. Standard is fifteen. Hard is twenty. Legendary is twenty five.
Attack rolls use specific attributes. Melee attacks add your Strength modifier. Ranged attacks use your Agility modifier. You roll against the target Defense DC.
Your Defense DC represents your evasion. It equals ten plus your Agility modifier. Armor provides damage reduction rather than increasing defense.
Hit outcomes scale by the success margin. A graze causes partial damage. A solid hit deals regular damage. A devastating blow inflicts massive harm.
A natural twenty always constitutes a critical success. A natural one represents a critical fumble. Fumbles introduce catastrophic narrative complications.
Initiative determines action order. You roll a d20 and add your Speed modifier. The highest total acts first during combat.
Poison inflicts ongoing narrative damage. The victim suffers debilitating pain each turn. They must seek a cure immediately.
Paralysis freezes the victim completely. They must skip their turn entirely. They become highly vulnerable regarding incoming attacks.
Diseases apply lingering penalties. The victim suffers reduced attribute scores. Temple healers can remove these afflictions.
Reaching zero health does not cause instant death. You fall unconscious or become captured. This provides narrative flexibility regarding failure.
